comparison.topic: Government announces a £2bn levy on large retailers' road deliveries
agreed_facts: The levy is £2bn and applies to large retailers.
The transport secretary announced it and says the money will go to rail freight.
comparison.main_difference: One text opens with the environmental purpose, one with the cost to retailers and shoppers, and the third reports both the purpose and the price warning.

wire.emphasis: The size of the levy and who pays it.

standard.emphasis: The likely effect on shoppers' bills.
